definition: National workers in establishments classified as 3914 Game software industry: establishments creating game software, including component programs, for home-TV game machines, portable electronic game machines and PCs, and conducting related research, analysis or advice. The classification excludes game-cassette and game-optical-disc manufacturing.
methodology: Economic Census activity survey; official national establishment tabulation. The published table notes that establishment, worker and sales values cover establishments for which required items were obtained, and excludes management/support establishments from this establishment tabulation.
scope_limits: Domestic establishment industry classification. It is not all employment at diversified game publishers or console-hardware companies, not a developer-occupation count, and not a contractor/FTE measure.
source_locator: PDF page2 / printed page1, Table I-1, JSIC3914 row
assessment: primary official source; dated and exact; candidate series anchor only. Do not interpolate or combine with CESA values.
trend_review: Approve a separate two-point, source-native Economic Census series for JSIC 3914 Game software industry establishment persons engaged. Do not join to JP_core_range or JP_broad. CESA's public estimates are undated, include console hardware in the core range, and broaden further to peripherals, distribution, retail, amusement, toys and media. Do not join to JP_status_2024, JP_status_2025, JP_freelancers_2024, or JP_freelancers_2025. CEDEC values are voluntary respondent shares, not national workforce stocks. Do not fill unobserved annual or post-2016 gaps, substitute a 2021 middle-classification/software/service table, or portray the 2016 value as a 2021 count. Do not join to METI Information and Communications Industry Basic Survey values. That enterprise survey is main-industry based and has a distinct enterprise universe and worker-status treatment; it is outside this review.

methodology: 2016 Economic Census Activity Survey, establishment industry tabulation, Service Industries B detailed class. The official results note says industry tabulations exclude establishments conducting only management/support activities and establishments for which industry-specific-item values were not obtained.
scope_limits: Domestic establishment-industry classification. It is not all employment at diversified game publishers or console-hardware companies, not a developer occupation count, and not an FTE or contractor total.

assessment: primary official source; exact dated detailed-class observation. It can extend the accepted 2012 census series, subject to the existing integration review.
acceptance_evidence: Main independently read official downloaded CSV header/3914 row and official r_serviceb.pdf notes3–4.
trend_review: Approve a separate two-point, source-native Economic Census series for JSIC 3914 Game software industry establishment persons engaged. Do not join to JP_core_range or JP_broad. CESA's public estimates are undated, include console hardware in the core range, and broaden further to peripherals, distribution, retail, amusement, toys and media. Do not join to JP_status_2024, JP_status_2025, JP_freelancers_2024, or JP_freelancers_2025. CEDEC values are voluntary respondent shares, not national workforce stocks. Do not fill unobserved annual or post-2016 gaps, substitute a 2021 middle-classification/software/service table, or portray the 2016 value as a 2021 count. That enterprise survey is main-industry based and has a distinct enterprise universe and worker-status treatment; it is outside this review.
